instruction.text: Sort these lengths from shortest to longest.
Select the most appropriate units to measure each length.

hint.text:
We can use any unit to measure any length. However, it is easier to visualise a length when the number is not too large or too small.

For example, if you wanted to measure the length of a standard swimming pool, in millimetres it would be 25,000. If you used kilometres, it would be 0.025. In metres, it measures 25 — a much easier amount to understand and visualise.
